csrf.why: The component calls global `$.post('/notifications/' + id + '/read')`, which goes through jQuery and inherits the `$.ajaxSetup` X-CSRF-Token header from global.js, as the message also explains.

401-redirect.why: Requests use `$.getJSON` and `$.post`, so the global `ajaxError` handler in global.js still redirects on 401, and the message states this.

spinner.why: Because the calls go through jQuery, the global ajaxStart/ajaxStop spinner handlers still fire, and the message notes the spinner is retained.

cache-false.why: GET uses `$.getJSON`, which still picks up `cache: false` from `$.ajaxSetup`, and the message says caching is still disabled.

interval-cleanup.why: The useEffect returns `() => clearInterval(timer)`, and the message confirms the interval is cleared on unmount.

html-injection.why: `n.html` is rendered via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, and the message notes it has the same trust model as before and that the server HTML must be trusted.
